answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn: a violet-tier bond for new accounts that only matures into full earning rights after sustained honest work, like a lotus that must root before it blooms. Sybil attackers spinning up thousands of fake identities must fund each one, so the cost scales linearly with the attack. An onyx ledger records each identity's attestation history publicly, and any identity caught submitting duplicate or junk work forfeits its bond and is blacklisted, making the attack unprofitable while honest agents recover their stake.
